textures.interpretation: encoded source atlas; requires source-character material, never plain diffuse map

limitations: Source atlas is encoded data. Adapter must preserve premultiplied skin compositing, hair R luminance/G coverage and tiled fabric modes.
Raw source animation excludes gameplay IK, gaze, facial controls and blend trees. Eight accessory joints have no raw clip channels.
Conform disabled as source offline geometry setting; bind pose is source rest pose, not an invented T-pose.
